name: code-skeptic-scanner-e2e
description: Playwright end-to-end layer for Code Skeptic Scanner, driven by its own self-contained Vite harness. Every script names a local binary; none is resolved through npx, which would fall back to the registry when the local one is absent. No script downloads a browser: Playwright 1.44.1's downloader does not verify the TLS chain of the host it fetches from (CVE-2025-59288), so browsers are provisioned out of band and browsers:verify checks for them without fetching. See docs/testing/DECISION-LOG.md rows D111 and D129.
